operating_bridge: ABNB and peer-platform guest nights to travel-platform volume
primary_feature_candidate: Country-month YoY guest-night growth and breadth
expected_guidance_link: Positive for nights and revenue when broad and available before cutoff
falsification_condition: No incremental guidance-residual improvement beyond seasonal baseline

operating_bridge: Regional platform guest nights to market breadth and mix
primary_feature_candidate: NUTS2 YoY growth breadth and weighted contribution
expected_guidance_link: Positive when large regions accelerate and signal is not concentrated
falsification_condition: Regional breadth does not improve country-level or ABNB guidance-residual forecast

operating_bridge: Fine regional guest nights to destination concentration
expected_guidance_link: Ambiguous because concentration can reflect mix and seasonality
falsification_condition: Concentration changes are unstable across releases or add no explanatory value

primary_feature_candidate: Platform guest-night growth minus total-accommodation growth
expected_guidance_link: Positive for relative platform share when the spread rises
falsification_condition: Platform-relative spread fails to lead ABNB operating or guidance residuals

operating_bridge: Registrations approvals denials revocations and complaints to effective STR capacity
primary_feature_candidate: Rolling approvals minus denials and revocations plus enforcement intensity
expected_guidance_link: More effective supply supports nights while stronger enforcement may reduce volume and raise pricing
falsification_condition: Monthly program flows do not track future capacity or are dominated by administrative batch timing

operating_bridge: Deplaned and enplaned passengers to destination activity
primary_feature_candidate: International deplaned passenger YoY growth and domestic breadth
expected_guidance_link: Positive for travel demand and potential nights in the Bay Area
falsification_condition: Passenger growth fails to lead accommodation demand after seasonality controls

operating_bridge: Traveller accommodation price index to ADR pressure
expected_guidance_link: Positive for pricing but series currently ends before ABNB public-history window

operating_bridge: Overnight international travellers to Canadian accommodation demand
primary_feature_candidate: Overnight non-resident visitor YoY growth by entry province
expected_guidance_link: Positive for nights in Canadian destination markets
falsification_condition: Traveller counts do not improve Canadian lodging-demand estimates after seasonality

operating_bridge: Airport terminal passengers to UK destination breadth
primary_feature_candidate: Airport-level May YoY growth breadth using current and prior-period fields
expected_guidance_link: Positive when growth is broad across major destination airports
falsification_condition: One-month breadth is unstable or unrelated to UK accommodation demand
